hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Production packer
function: The downhole seal between the tubing and the casing above the perforations that isolates the annulus from produced fluids and pressure.

tabs.overview: Set hydraulically or mechanically; a permanent packer is milled out, a retrievable packer is released and pulled. The tubing lands in it through a seal assembly so the tubing can move with temperature.
tabs.engineering: Per API 11D1 validation grades; rating for differential from above and below; elastomers for the fluids and temperature.
tabs.connections: Tubing above through the seal assembly; casing wall.
tabs.safety: Annulus pressure monitoring shows a packer leak.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
tabs.operations: Set once the tubing is landed; tested from the annulus.
tabs.failure_modes: Element leaks, slips not holding, seal assembly leaks.

standards.paraphrase: Packer and bridge plug validation grades.
